# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION FOR GROUP DIFFERENCE RECOVERY
# ============================================================================
# This script loads the saved results from the parameter recovery simulation (group difference) & makes plots
# Namely: a plot for mu recovery of groups, another for contrasts between groups, and density plots of recovered values
# Also: some metrics for the density plot
# ALL PLOTS (i think) NEED TO BE IN PROBABILITY SPACE, BUT RMSE AND SUCH NEED TO BE CALCULATED IN PROBIT SPACE IN ORDER TO BE MEANINGFUL FOR RECOVERY (otherwise they get squashed!)
# ============================================================================

```{r}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggpubr, gridExtra, grid)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# PATHS
# ---------------------------
root_path <- "~/IGT_LLM_DecisionMaking"
results_dir <- file.path(root_path, "src/3_simulation/recovery/results/group_diff") 
plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------
# CONSTANTS
# ---------------------------
GROUPS <- c("human", "gpt2023", "gpt2025")
GROUP_COLORS <- c(human = "#3498db", gpt2023 = "#e74c3c", gpt2025 = "#fcc200")

CONTRAST_NAMES <- c(
gpt2023_human   = "gpt23 − hc",
gpt2025_human   = "gpt25 − hc",
gpt2025_gpt2023 = "gpt25 − gpt23"
)
CONTRAST_COLORS <- c("purple", "#EB931A", '#27C237' )

PARAMS <- c("prob_stay_win", "prob_switch_lose")
PARAM_LABELS <- c(
prob_stay_win  = "P(Stay | Win)",
prob_switch_lose = "P(Switch | Lose)"
)

probit_to_prob <- pnorm #function to convert probit to probability (if needed)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# LOAD DATA
# ---------------------------
results <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "group_params_recovery.csv"))

#contrasts (in probit AND probability space)
contrasts <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "group_contrasts_recovery.csv"))

#samples & true params
samples_list <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "samples_list.rds"))
true_params  <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "true_params.rds"))
```


# ---------------------------
# 1. GROUP μ RECOVERY (plot in PROBABILITY space, metrics in PROBIT space to not deinflate them)
# ---------------------------
```{r}
# Pivot results to long format (line up the datasets nicely)
mu_long <- results %>%
  select(sim_id, group, starts_with("true_mu_"), starts_with("rec_mu_"), 
         -ends_with("_prob")) %>% #don't need this (probability)
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("true_mu_"), starts_with("rec_mu_")),
    names_to = c("type", "param"),
    names_pattern = "(true|rec)_mu_(.*)"
  ) # Keep in probit space for now (this is the probit version)

# Create probability version for plotting
mu_long_prob <- mu_long %>%
  mutate(value = probit_to_prob(value)) # Convert to probability space for display

# Pivot to wide for plotting (probability space)
mu_wide_prob <- mu_long_prob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

# Pivot to wide for metrics calculation (probit space)
mu_wide_probit <- mu_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

#get the true vals for each group (in probability space for plotting)
true_by_group <- mu_long_prob %>%
  filter(type == "true") %>%
  group_by(group, param) %>%
  summarise(true_mu = unique(value), .groups = "drop")

mu_plots <- map(PARAMS, function(param){
  df_prob <- mu_wide_prob %>% filter(param == !!param) 
  df_probit <- mu_wide_probit %>% filter(param == !!param)
  true_vals <- true_by_group %>% filter(param == !!param)
  
  # Calculate stats per group IN PROBIT SPACE
  stats_by_group <- df_probit %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((rec - true)^2)),
      Bias = mean(rec - true),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Create stats label with per-group metrics (could have been a separate function)
  stats_label <- paste(
    sapply(1:nrow(stats_by_group), function(i) {
      sprintf("%s: RMSE=%.2f Bias=%.2f",
              stats_by_group$group[i],
              stats_by_group$RMSE[i],
              stats_by_group$Bias[i])
    }),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  
  #actual plot (group mu recovery) - PLOT IN PROBABILITY SPACE
  ggplot(df_prob, aes(x = true, y = rec, color = group)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = "Recovered"), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = true_vals, aes(x = true_mu, y = true_mu, shape = "True Value"), 
               color = "black", size = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("True Value" = 17, "Recovered" = 16), 
                       name = "Point Type:") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1)+ #identity line (perfect recovery)
    labs(
      title = PARAM_LABELS[param],
      x = "True Probability",
      y = "Recovered Probability",
      color = "Group:"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = min(df_prob$true), y = max(df_prob$rec), 
      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, fontface="italic"
    )
})

#combine with a title
combined_mu <- ggarrange(plotlist = mu_plots, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top") %>%
  annotate_figure(
    top = text_grob("Recovered Mu per Group (Probability Space Display, Probit Metrics)", 
                    face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

#save
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mu_recovery_by_group_prob_ggplot.png"),
       plot = combined_mu, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```


# ---------------------------
# 2. GROUP CONTRAST RECOVERY (plot in PROBABILITY space, metrics in PROBIT space to not deinflate them)
# ---------------------------
```{r}
# Pivot contrasts to long format (getting the data) - separate probit and prob versions (both are calculated as contrasts in group_diff_recovery)
contrast_long_probit <- contrasts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ends_with("_probit")),
    names_to = c("type", "contrast"),
    names_pattern = "(true_diff|rec_diff)_(.*)_probit"
  )

contrast_long_prob <- contrasts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ends_with("_prob")),
    names_to = c("type", "contrast"),
    names_pattern = "(true_diff|rec_diff)_(.*)_prob"
  )

#getting true values for each contrast (in probability space for plotting)
true_by_group <- contrast_long_prob %>%
  filter(type == "true_diff") %>%
  group_by(contrast, parameter) %>%
  summarise(true_mu = unique(value), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot wide for plotting (probability space - has the true and rec next to each other!!! nicely)
contrast_wide_prob <- contrast_long_prob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

# Pivot wide for metrics (probit space)
contrast_wide_probit <- contrast_long_probit %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value)

contrast_plots <- map(PARAMS, function(param){
  df_prob <- contrast_wide_prob %>% filter(parameter == param)
  df_probit <- contrast_wide_probit %>% filter(parameter == param)
  true_vals <- true_by_group %>% filter(parameter == param) #unique operator
  
  # Calculate stats per contrast IN PROBIT SPACE
  stats_by_contrast <- df_probit %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((rec_diff - true_diff)^2)),
      Bias = mean(rec_diff - true_diff),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Get plot limits for positioning
  x_range <- range(df_prob$true_diff)
  y_range <- range(df_prob$rec_diff)
  
  # Create stats label with per-contrast metrics
  stats_label <- paste(
    sapply(1:nrow(stats_by_contrast), function(i) {
      sprintf("%s: RMSE=%.2f Bias=%.2f",
              CONTRAST_NAMES[stats_by_contrast$contrast[i]],
              stats_by_contrast$RMSE[i],
              stats_by_contrast$Bias[i])
    }),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  
  #actual plot - PLOT IN PROBABILITY SPACE
  ggplot(df_prob, aes(x = true_diff, y = rec_diff, color = contrast)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, aes(shape = "Recovered")) +
    geom_point(data = data.frame(x = 0, y = 0),aes(x, y, shape = "Zero Point (Comparison Point)"),size = 5,color = "black")+
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = CONTRAST_COLORS, labels = CONTRAST_NAMES)+
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Point Type:", values = c("Recovered" = 16, "True Value" = 17, "Zero Point (Comparison Point)" = 8))+ #all the shapes for the points
    labs(
      title = PARAM_LABELS[param],
      x = "True Probability Difference",
      y = "Recovered Probability Difference",
      color = "Contrast:"
    ) +
    geom_point(data = true_vals, aes(x = true_mu, y = true_mu, shape = "True Value"), size = 4, color = "black")+
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    annotate(
      "text", 
      x = x_range[1],y = y_range[2], label = stats_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3, lineheight = 0.9, fontface = "italic" #some fuckery so it looks ok
    )
})

#combine with a title
combined_contrast <- ggarrange(plotlist = contrast_plots, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top") %>%
  annotate_figure(
    top = text_grob("Group Difference Contrasts (Probability Space Display, Probit Metrics)\nOrdering by |Distance| from 0", 
                    face = "bold", size = 14))

#save
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "group_contrast_recovery_prob_ggplot.png"),
       plot = combined_contrast, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```



# ---------------------------
# 3. DENSITY PLOT OF THE RECOVERED VALUES VS THE ONE TRUE VALUE FOR EACH PARAM (THE GROUND TRUTH)
# ---------------------------
```{r}
#get the data using samples_list
density_plots <- map(PARAMS, function(param){
  posterior_df <- bind_rows(lapply(1:length(samples_list), function(sim_id){
    samp <- samples_list[[sim_id]]
    param_col <- paste0("mu_", param, "_raw")
    
    bind_rows(lapply(1:length(GROUPS), function(group_idx){
      tibble(
        group = GROUPS[group_idx],
        value = probit_to_prob(samp[[param_col]][, group_idx]),
        # take the raws (non-probit) and convert to probabilities (can do since individual values)
        sim_id = sim_id
      )
    }))
  }))
  
  #single true val for each grp
  true_df <- tibble(
    group = GROUPS,
    value = sapply(1:length(GROUPS), function(i) {
      g <- GROUPS[i]
      param_name <- paste0(param, "_raw")
      probit_to_prob(true_params[[g]]$mu[[param_name]])
    })
    #take the raw value and turn it from probit to prob
  )
  
  #actual plot
  ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = value, fill = group)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +  
    facet_wrap(~group, scales = "fixed") + 
    geom_vline(
      data = true_df,
      aes(xintercept = value),
      color = "black",        
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1
    )+
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS) + #color by grp
    labs(
      title = paste("Posterior Density of", PARAM_LABELS[param]),
      x = "Probability",
      y = "Density",
      fill = "Group:"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top", #remove it?
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
})

# Combine with title and save
combined_density <- ggarrange(plotlist = density_plots, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "top") %>%
  annotate_figure(
    top = text_grob("Density Plots of Recovered Mu Posteriors by Group (Probability Space)", 
                    face = "bold", size = 14))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mu_density_by_group_prob_ggplot.png"),
       plot = combined_density, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# ---------------------------
# 3.5 TABLE OF METRICS FOR THE DENSITY PLOT
# ---------------------------
```{r}
# Calculate metrics for density plots (in probit space!)
# This mirrors the approach in sections 1 & 2: calculate per-sim, then aggregate
density_metrics <- map_dfr(PARAMS, function(param) {
  
  # Get the true value for each group (same structure as used in density plot section 3)
  true_vals <- tibble(
    group = GROUPS,
    true_val = sapply(1:length(GROUPS), function(i) {
      g <- GROUPS[i]
      param_name <- paste0(param, "_raw")
      true_params[[g]]$mu[[param_name]]
    })
  )
  
  # Calculate metrics per simulation per group
  sim_summaries <- map_dfr(1:length(samples_list), function(sim_id) {
    samp <- samples_list[[sim_id]]
    param_col <- paste0("mu_", param, "_raw")
    
    map_dfr(1:length(GROUPS), function(group_idx) {
      group <- GROUPS[group_idx]
      true_val <- true_vals$true_val[true_vals$group == group]
      post_samples <- samp[[param_col]][, group_idx]
      
      tibble(
        group = group,
        sim_id = sim_id,
        true_val = true_val,
        post_mean = mean(post_samples),
        post_median = median(post_samples),
        post_sd = sd(post_samples),
        ci_lower = quantile(post_samples, 0.025),
        ci_upper = quantile(post_samples, 0.975),
        coverage = true_val >= ci_lower & true_val <= ci_upper
      )
    })
  })

   
  # Aggregate across simulations to get recovery performance
  sim_summaries %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      parameter = param,
      true_val_probit = unique(true_val),
      mean_post_mean = mean(post_mean),
      mean_post_sd = mean(post_sd),
      mean_ci_lower = mean(ci_lower),
      mean_ci_upper = mean(ci_upper),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((post_mean - true_val)^2)),
      Bias = mean(post_mean - true_val),
      Coverage = mean(coverage),  # Proportion of sims where 95% CI contained true value
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    relocate(parameter, group)
})

# Format for display
density_metrics_table <- density_metrics %>%
  mutate(
    Parameter = PARAM_LABELS[parameter],
    Group = group,
    `True (Probit)` = sprintf("%.3f", true_val_probit),
    `Mean (Probit)` = sprintf("%.3f", mean_post_mean),
    `SD (Probit)` = sprintf("%.3f", mean_post_sd),
    `95% CI (Probit)` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", mean_ci_lower, mean_ci_upper),
    RMSE = sprintf("%.3f", RMSE),
    Bias = sprintf("%.3f", Bias),
    `Coverage (95% Credible Interval)` = sprintf("%.0f%%", Coverage * 100)
  ) %>%
  select(Parameter, Group, `True (Probit)`, `Mean (Probit)`, `SD (Probit)`, 
         `95% CI (Probit)`, RMSE, Bias, `Coverage (95% Credible Interval)`)

# Create table grob
table_grob <- tableGrob(density_metrics_table, rows = NULL, 
                        theme = ttheme_minimal(
                          core = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.1)),
                          colhead = list(fg_params = list(fontface = "bold"))))

# Add title
title <- grid::textGrob("Density Plot Metrics (Probit Space)", 
                        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))

table_with_title <- arrangeGrob(title, table_grob, 
                                heights = c(0.1, 0.9), nrow = 2)

# Save as PNG
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mu_density_metrics_table.png"), 
       plot = table_with_title, width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# Save as CSV
write.csv(density_metrics_table, file.path(plot_dir, "mu_density_metrics.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# ---------------------------
# 4. CONTRAST DETECTION RATE
# How often the 95% credible interval of each group difference excludes 0
# ---------------------------

```{r}
contrast_rows <- list()   # will hold one row per simulation x parameter x contrast

for (sim in 1:length(samples_list)) {
  samp <- samples_list[[sim]]

  for (param in PARAMS) {
    # Posterior draws of each group's mean (probit scale)
    # Columns: 1 = human, 2 = gpt2023, 3 = gpt2025
    draws   <- samp[[paste0("mu_", param, "_raw")]]
    human   <- draws[, 1]
    gpt2023 <- draws[, 2]
    gpt2025 <- draws[, 3]

    # Group differences, computed draw by draw
    # (this gives the full posterior of each difference)
    differences <- list(
      gpt2023_human   = gpt2023 - human,
      gpt2025_human   = gpt2025 - human,
      gpt2025_gpt2023 = gpt2025 - gpt2023
    )

    for (contrast in names(differences)) {
      d     <- differences[[contrast]]
      lower <- unname(quantile(d, 0.025))   # bottom of the 95% interval
      upper <- unname(quantile(d, 0.975))   # top of the 95% interval

      contrast_rows[[length(contrast_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        sim_id        = sim,
        parameter     = param,
        contrast      = contrast,
        lower         = lower,
        upper         = upper,
        excludes_zero = lower > 0 | upper < 0   # TRUE = a clear difference
      )
    }
  }
}

# Stack all rows into one table
contrast_detect <- do.call(rbind, contrast_rows)

# Detection rate = share of simulations where the interval excludes 0
# (the mean of TRUE/FALSE values is the proportion of TRUEs)
detection_summary <- aggregate(excludes_zero ~ parameter + contrast,
                               data = contrast_detect, FUN = mean)
names(detection_summary)[3] <- "detection_rate"
```


```{r}
# True difference in probability space, for the axis labels
true_prob <- function(group, param) {
  pnorm(true_params[[group]]$mu[[paste0(param, "_raw")]])
}

detection_summary$true_diff <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(detection_summary)) {
  param  <- detection_summary$parameter[i]
  groups <- strsplit(detection_summary$contrast[i], "_")[[1]]  # "gpt2025_human" -> "gpt2025", "human"
  detection_summary$true_diff[i] <- true_prob(groups[1], param) - true_prob(groups[2], param)
}

# Labels: contrast name + its true difference, and the parameter name for the panel title
detection_summary$label <- paste0(CONTRAST_NAMES[detection_summary$contrast],
                                  "\n(true diff = ", sprintf("%+.2f", detection_summary$true_diff), ")")
detection_summary$param_label <- PARAM_LABELS[detection_summary$parameter]

# Same colours as the contrast plot
contrast_fill <- c(gpt2023_human   = "purple",
                   gpt2025_gpt2023 = "#EB931A",
                   gpt2025_human   = "#27C237")

detection_plot <- ggplot(detection_summary,
                         aes(x = label, y = detection_rate, fill = contrast)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", detection_rate * 100)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed") +   # common power threshold
  facet_wrap(~ param_label, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = contrast_fill) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.08), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Contrast Detection Rate",
    subtitle = "Share of simulations where the 95% credible interval of the difference excludes 0 (dashed line = 80%)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Detection rate"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",                 # the x-axis labels already name each contrast
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Save plot and the numbers behind it
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "contrast_detection_rate.png"),
       plot = detection_plot, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

write.csv(detection_summary[, c("parameter", "contrast", "true_diff", "detection_rate")],
          file.path(plot_dir, "contrast_detection_rate.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
